sources.name: Europe PMC / PubMed MED
sources.query: (TITLE_ABS:"CAR-T" OR TITLE_ABS:"CAR T" OR TITLE_ABS:"chimeric antigen receptor" OR TITLE_ABS:axicabtagene OR TITLE_ABS:tisagenlecleucel OR TITLE_ABS:lisocabtagene OR TITLE_ABS:brexucabtagene) AND (TITLE:lymphoma OR TITLE:DLBCL OR TITLE:LBCL) AND SRC:MED
notes: Exclusions are corrections, retractions, and the held-out 2023 ASTCT guideline.
Title must name lymphoma, DLBCL, or LBCL; CAR-T terms may appear in title or abstract.
Topic-query relevance is not individually adjudicated.

sources.name: CMS NPPES NPI Registry
notes: Registry practice locations may be stale and are not credentialing.

sources.name: CMS Open Payments
notes: General payments only; research payments and ownership are not collected.
The site shows manufacturer counts and payment natures, never dollar amounts.
Payments are industry transfers of value, not prescribing or influence.

sources.name: CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners by Provider and Service
notes: Not used in any community or composite score: only 7 HCPs have a selected drug code.
Absence of a published row is not evidence of no activity; small cells are suppressed.

sources.name: Public LinkedIn search listings
notes: Found by public web search; no follower, post, or engagement metrics were collected.

sources.name: 2023 ASTCT DLBCL clinical practice recommendations
notes: Withheld from every feature and every edge at build time, so it is a clean label.

tables.grain: one row per undirected HCP pair with a shared paper
one row per NPI × HCPCS × setting

scope_limitations: topic-query relevance is not individually adjudicated
registry active status is not proof of current clinical practice
no patient-level copays, treatment volumes or actual referrals
citation counts were observed in 2026 and cannot serve as historical 2025 features
No published row does not imply no activity; suppression reason is unobservable.
Counts cover published Medicare FFS Part B non-institutional cells only.
Drug-code activity does not establish DLBCL diagnosis or CAR-T eligibility.
0540T covers CAR-T administration across indications; it is not lymphoma-specific.
Drug services are code-specific billing units; no services sum across incompatible families is provided.
Beneficiary-days summed across codes/settings can repeat the same person-day.
No unique-patient total is derived by adding beneficiary counts.
Payment estimates multiply rounded published average payments by units; not exact reimbursement, income, or patient copays.
Only 2024 is collected; no utilization trend is inferred.
Original 2026-observed publication/network features are unsuitable as prospective predictors of 2024 outcomes.
sources.legacy_pilot: A 2025 pilot cohort of 245 clinicians exists only in the local project; its curated seeds are not part of this site.
